trap.label: actually
trap.wrong: Actually, I work in a bank.
trap.right: Currently, I work in a bank.
trap.why: Actually em inglês = na verdade, não atualmente.

fix.wrong: Actually I am studying English this month.
fix.right: Currently I am studying English this month.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com however: “It's hard but fun.”
rewrite.answer: It is hard; however, it is fun.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com furthermore: “It pays well. It is flexible.”
rewrite.answer: It pays well; furthermore, it is flexible.

rewrite.prompt: Passe ao passado: “She takes a course.”
